registered: 2026-08-18, BEFORE the operator is written or fitted
name: DIRECTION-VS-RATE susceptibility (candidate original physics)
why_it_is_new: Every operator in the field — bounded confidence, kinetic collision kernels, Light Society's influence lookup — moves agents TOWARD something shared, and susceptibility (where it exists) sets HOW FAST. This operator makes per-agent susceptibility set WHERE the agent moves in force space, not how quickly.
mechanical_claim: It explains the measured event-leg failure directly: a uniform-direction shove produces variance ratio 0.16 and rank correlation -0.41 by construction. Direction heterogeneity produces population variance without changing the aggregate.
design_constraint: The per-agent susceptibility vectors are normalized so the POPULATION-MEAN response equals today's uniform response. The aggregate (ratio 0.97, the one thing that works) is preserved BY CONSTRUCTION; only the distribution of directions changes.
machinery_already_present: dynamics.py has per-agent per-force susceptibility and trait residue; the build is connection and re-parameterization, not construction. Known levers measured: thresholds set above reachable range (0.602 vs 0.7), residue 0.0005/layer, averaging kernel differentiates rate but not direction.

DISCRIMINATING TEST (thresholds pre-stat.arm_A_who_reacts: rank correlation between predicted and observed per-country reaction magnitude on HELD-OUT reaction cases. Baseline -0.41. Threshold: >= +0.30 to count.
DISCRIMINATING TEST (thresholds pre-stat.arm_B_spread: variance ratio (simulated/real) must move from 0.16 into [0.5, 1.5].
DISCRIMINATING TEST (thresholds pre-stat.arm_C_aggregate_preserved: aggregate magnitude ratio must stay >= 0.90 (currently 0.97). A win that breaks the aggregate is not a win.
DISCRIMINATING TEST (thresholds pre-stat.arm_D_not_a_knob: fitted susceptibility must correlate with an INDEPENDENT agent property (education, age, network degree) rather than being arbitrary per-country tuning; report the correlation.
DISCRIMINATING TEST (thresholds pre-stat.failure_reading: arms A+B pass but D fails => country-level tuning wearing an agent-level costume; arms fail => reject and record, as with polar.

fitting_protocol: parameters fit on a subset of the six historical reaction cases, scored on the held-out cases; no fitting on the scored cases; production untouched (flag-gated).
